So going to a mechanic was scary knowing how dishonest they can be especially to women. I had some tires done at Jiffy/Tire Kingdom and was told that I needed my stabilizer, shocks and struts done on my truck. I wanted to get pricing from different places and was recommended Benny's by many people here in the Homestead. Monica at the front desk took care of me we arranged for work to be done the following week. I was quoted just a tiny bit more then Jiffy but having so many recommendations I chose them anyways. When I dropped off my truck they had called me telling me my shocks and struts were fine all I needed was to take care of the stabilizer. I was shocked with their honesty and they saved me 1200.00. All the staff at Benny's especially Monica were so nice I couldn't have been happier. It's hard to find honest reliable mechanics. Now I know why many businesses here in the Homestead use and highly recommend them. I have never left a review for a mechanic shop but I want people to know you couldn't pick a better place for work to be done. Their honesty and time spent on mechanical work outstanding. They really go above and beyond to help. Can't say enough good things about Benny Auto and Repair.
